title: Ctrl+Alt+T should open the default terminal instead of Konsole
line: Ctrl+Alt+T now opens whichever terminal is set as default instead of always Konsole.
explanation: Ctrl+Alt+T was never a Plasma shortcut: Konsole's desktop file declares X-KDE-Shortcuts=Ctrl+Alt+T, so kglobalaccel launched Konsole itself regardless of the default terminal chosen in Default Applications. plasmashell now registers an "Open Terminal" global action (Ctrl+Alt+T) that starts the default terminal through KTerminalLauncherJob in the home folder, re-reading kdeglobals so a changed default applies right away, and Konsole drops its own shortcut. The desktop menu's optional Open Terminal entry also shows the shortcut.

commits.message:
shell: add a global Ctrl+Alt+T shortcut to open the default terminal

The only Ctrl+Alt+T shortcut came from Konsole's own desktop file, so it
always opened Konsole even when another terminal was set as default. Add
an Open Terminal action to plasmashell that launches the default one.

BUG: 464004

desktop: stop registering Ctrl+Alt+T as a global shortcut

Konsole claimed Ctrl+Alt+T for itself, so the shortcut opened Konsole no
matter which terminal was set as default. Plasma now owns this shortcut
and opens the default terminal, which is still Konsole out of the box.

BUG: 464004

patches.diff:
From 734446941a968af98f0bac3af44257475557a7a9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:06:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktop: stop registering Ctrl+Alt+T as a global shortcut

Konsole claimed Ctrl+Alt+T for itself, so the shortcut opened Konsole no
matter which terminal was set as default. Plasma now owns this shortcut
and opens the default terminal, which is still Konsole out of the box.

BUG: 464004
---
 desktop/org.kde.konsole.desktop | 1 -
 1 file changed, 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktop/org.kde.konsole.desktop b/desktop/org.kde.konsole.desktop
index b935784a6..5d1f9202a 100755
--- a/desktop/org.kde.konsole.desktop
+++ b/desktop/org.kde.konsole.desktop
@@ -8,7 +8,6 @@ Actions=NewWindow;NewTab;
 X-DocPath=konsole/index.html
 StartupNotify=true
 X-KDE-AuthorizeAction=shell_access
-X-KDE-Shortcuts=Ctrl+Alt+T
 StartupWMClass=konsole
 X-TerminalArgExec=-e
 X-TerminalArgDir=--workdir
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Default terminal set to Xfce Terminal; Ctrl+Alt+T still opens Konsole
Same setup: Ctrl+Alt+T opens Xfce Terminal, focused, in the home folder
Desktop menu with Open Terminal enabled: no shortcut shown
